BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Nurethoth!
Finally, you apostates reached here!
I broke the seal while you were fighting my\nshadows.\nNow, I'll take you down and make this world ours!!
W-W-Waaaaaahhh!!
I am Nurethoth the God of Delso...\nThe God in another dimension and I am ruling the\nliving things totally different from you...
I happened to feel this guy calling the Ancient\nGod or something like that.\nThen I came up with an idea to impersonate it...
I said that I would restore the collapsed world\nand told him to summon me to this world.\nAll this is to invade this world...
But when I passed through the gate, he and two\nother guys found out who I am.\nThey pushed me back and sealed the gate...
But I didn't give up my invasion plan...While he\nwas sealing the gate, I kept diffusing the miasma\nfrom my world and it affected his body...
The result, I succeeded in creating my shadows\nusing his body. And I sent out the monsters from\nmy world through the crack of the seal...
And now, I'm back again here!
...All I need to do is destroy his body to break\nthe seal completely... And open up the way to\ndominate this world!! Ha ha ha!
You are no match for me. Just obey me.\nHelp me break the seal, and you can become my\nsubordinate. You may rule a part of this world.
I don't think so.
You said you used the wizard's body to enter\nthis world...
That means, your body isn't yours, is it?!
W-What are you talkin' about?!
The monsters look like the living things in this\nworld as they get far from the gate. That means\nyou can't completely control them, right?
That's why you asked the adventurer for help!\nIsn't it?!
S-Shut uuuuup!!
Let's do it!!
T-The gate...\n...I just need to open the gate!!
Sorcery Gem!!
Whoa?! The gate...!\nWait, don't close! My power will be gone...\nAggghhhhh!!
It's over...\nYou stopped the evil existence that might cause\na disaster in this world. I appreciate it.
Umm... He was sealing the gate with his own body.\nHe's seriously injured...\nLet's take him to Naiata...
Finished?\n...Wow! The gate disappeared!!\nyay!
*sigh*\nHow easygoing as always...
